component.name: Mirror Magic
component.summary: Puzzle game where you steer a beam of light using mirrors

description.p: MirrorMagic is a game where you shoot around obstacles to collect energy using your beam. It is similar to "Mindbender" (Amiga) from the same author.

The goal is to work out how to get around obstacles to shoot energy containers with your beam, thereby opening the path to the next level. Included are many levels familiar from the games "Deflektor" and "Mindbender".
